Home.title: Piano Daily
Home.tagline: Clear scores, organised by skill level, easy to preview and easy to find.

levelDesc.beginner: Get to know the keys, finger exercises and familiar melodies.
levelDesc.intermediate: Build speed and complexity with classical and modern pieces.
levelDesc.advanced: Demanding technique and multiple voices for confident players.
levelDesc.expert: Concert repertoire that asks for the highest level of technique and expression.

Convert.title: Convert sheet music PDF to MIDI
Convert.intro: Upload a score (PDF, image or MusicXML), see the staff, listen to it and download the MIDI file.

Convert.loginBody: Reading a score takes a lot of computing, so it is available to logged-in members only.

Convert.runningHint: This can take from a few seconds to a few minutes. You can keep this page open.

Convert.unreadableBody: Try a sharper, cleaner PDF, or a MusicXML file.
